metadata.name: Read part of a web page
metadata.author: recued-core
metadata.description: Use “Read part of a web page” in Recued. Read one part of a page in full, as cleaned HTML with its addresses and ids: a region by CSS selector, such as main or an #id the outline names, or an element by its ref. Use it for what an outline leaves out, a part that changed, or the rest of a page an inspection cut short. Opens the page first if no tab shows it.

ref.help: The ref of an element to read, such as e12, from the latest inspection of this page. Leave it empty when passing a selector.
ref.label: Element

page.help: The page's address, such as https://example.com/orders, whether a tab shows it or not: with none showing it, the page is opened in a new tab first, which asks you unless allowed on that site. Or a page handle a listing, an opening, a read or an action answered, copied exactly.
page.label: Page

selector.help: A CSS selector for the part to read, such as main or #results. The first match is read. Leave it empty to read the element named by ref instead.
selector.label: Part of the page
